zh: 這個不要辣,我不太能吃辣。
reference: No spicy for this one, please — I can't really handle spicy food.
inputTranscript: 这 个 不 要 啦 , 我 不 太 能 吃 辣 。
outputTranscript: I don't want this one; I can't really eat spicy food.

judge.reason: The machine translation incorrectly translates '這個不要辣' (No spicy for this one) as 'I don't want this one' (我不要這個), which changes the meaning from requesting a non-spicy preparation to rejecting the item entirely. This is a significant omission/mistranslation of the word '辣' (spicy) in the first clause, although the second clause is translated perfectly.
